Population increased in Mole Valley

The estimated population of Mole Valley in 2024 was 88,709 usual residents, a rise of 0.2% since 2023.

This meant that Mole Valley's rate of population change placed it among the slowest growing 20 percent of local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Mole Valley increased by 1.3%.

Over this slightly longer period, Mole Valley was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Mole Valley

The average (median) age stayed at 47.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Mole Valley has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Mole Valley is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Mole Valley's population of 88,709 usual residents was made up of:

  • 15,221 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.2%)
  • 51,699 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.3%)
  • 21,789 people aged 65 years and over, (24.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Mole Valley has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (24.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Mole Valley, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Mole Valley
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Mole Valley, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 303 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 632 births and 935 deaths in Mole Valley.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 109 (0.1%). There were 6,134 people entering the area and 6,025 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Mole Valley's population of 361 (0.4%) as a result of 653 people entering the area and 292 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Mole Valley was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Mole Valley in mid-2023 is 88,529.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 206 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 57 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 263 people.
